reported_success.quote: When an item was in the self-paced onset condition, memory for that item was better than when it was in the fixed-pace condition. The overall effect size is small, and it is difficult to discern if this effect alone demonstrates a benefit to self-pacing stimuli onset.

notes: The original locators use article-relative pages, excluding the author-copy cover sheet. The replication p. 10 locator identifies the pooled onset-control analysis, not the direct offset-control replication in Experiment 1 on journal p. 710. Thus the located replication contrast differs conceptually from the original duration/offset contrast; target_match refers to the supplied neutral description and page locator. No metric conversion or n reconstruction was performed. Original p is the authors’ section-wide printed significance bound, not an exact p. The item-level narrative is classified mixed because the authors report better item memory while questioning whether this establishes a benefit.
